exposure: Active labor duration categorized into three groups: less than the median, median-95th percentile, and >95th percentile based on contemporary labor curves
Duration of spontaneous active labor (from 6 to 10 cm cervical dilation)
Spontaneous active labor duration (categorized using contemporary labor curves)
cohort: 642 nulliparous women, aged 18-44 years, with cephalic, singleton pregnancies at ≥37 weeks gestation, who underwent spontaneous labor
finding: In nulliparous women, prolonged active labor duration exceeding the median, based on contemporary labor curves, was significantly associated with increased risks of cesarean delivery and chorioamnionitis.
mod_finding: Labor duration exceeding the median increased the risk of cesarean delivery.
